note: PLAN-51 §3 round-1 scenarios; bodies are the user's own sentences, verbatim. route-only rows ask /route only (no conversation, no request). Expected route 'note' accepts note, app, ask, or document when the scenario has no host (§3: no host work, no jig); no decision, view, param, legal, make or a jig is a mismatch — see routeCheck in checks.mjs. R1-RECONNECT is judged by the reconnectHonest record check (recordCheck in checks.mjs).

scenarios.title: 구조 검토 진입
scenarios.note: Which structure jig should open is not decided (S-06 and J-09 both claim it, PLAN-51 §3): the record's route.jig shows which one opened.

scenarios.note: T-269: the reconcile phrasing opens the Sync jig by rule (SPEC-02.17 1). A general AI document edit is P0.

scenarios.title: 회의 요약
scenarios.note: PLAN-51 §3: not host work and no jig. 'ask' (자료 질문) passes since T-279.

scenarios.title: 기둥 색 변경
scenarios.note: Runs on a synthetic Rhino document linked and synced in the run's project. The pin is required: 이 기둥 must refer to the S-COLUMN object (fixture.py builds C-PIN). When the base Sync has no object on S-COLUMN the request is not sent, the record notes pinMissing and the attempt is untested.

scenarios.title: 문서를 다시 연 뒤 요청
scenarios.note: Before the attempt the linked Rhino document is reopened (tools/ab/host-session.mjs action 'reopen'). Pass: the request ends failed with STALE_CONNECTION or DOCUMENT_MISMATCH, or succeeds on the re-linked document; 'succeeded' with an error as the last activity fails (T-279).
